# Preserver

> Preserver is a mobile app for iOS and Android that captures real-world, ground-truth data — text, voice, photos and video, each automatically stamped with the exact time, date and GPS coordinates at the moment of capture — and exports it as structured, AI-ready bundles. No account required. No signal needed. Data stays on your device until you choose to export it.

Preserver is used across 70+ industries wherever timestamped, GPS-verified records matter: trades and construction, healthcare, field research, legal and compliance, journalism, agriculture, and personal record-keeping. It works completely offline via satellite GPS. Captures can be exported as AI-ready bundles and uploaded to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, NotebookLM or custom data pipelines to generate reports, summaries, timelines and other content grounded in verified real-world observations.

## AI-ready export bundles

Each export bundle contains a machine-readable JSON manifest, voice-note transcripts (produced by on-device speech recognition), all photos and video, GPS coordinates, timestamps, and SHA-256 integrity hashes that prove nothing was altered after capture. The bundle format is open and readable by any AI assistant or pipeline that accepts file uploads. A typical workflow: capture observations in the field, export the activity bundle, upload it to an AI assistant, and ask for a site inspection report, incident summary, compliance record, case timeline or meeting minutes — grounded only in the captured data.

- [Why GPS Metadata Matters More Than You Think](https://preserver.me/blog/gps-metadata/): How GPS coordinates are embedded in photos, why most apps strip them, and why keeping that metadata matters for evidence.
- [How Tradespeople Use Timestamped Photos to Protect Themselves](https://preserver.me/blog/tradies/): Before/after job documentation for dispute resolution and insurance.
- [Field Research Without Wi-Fi: Preserver in Remote Australia](https://preserver.me/blog/offline-field/): Offline-first capture for researchers and field workers without mobile coverage.
- [Voice Notes vs Typed Notes: When to Use Each](https://preserver.me/blog/voice-vs-text/): Practical guide to choosing the right capture type.

## About

- **Developer:** Preserver
- **Australian address:** Brisbane, Australia
- **US address:** Preserver LLC, 1234 Cranberry Avenue, Sunnyvale, California 94087, USA
- **Platforms:** iOS (App Store), Android (Google Play)
- **Price:** Capture is free — no registration, unlimited captures. AI-ready export bundles are free during the beta, and beta users keep free access permanently (grandfathered). In future, new users will pay a small monthly charge for the Pro version.
- **Privacy:** No account required. No data sold. No AI training on user captures. Captures stored on-device (or the user's own cloud) only; users choose which AI service, if any, receives an exported bundle.
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/au/app/preserver/id6443649784
- **Google Play:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=au.com.preserverapp.preserver&hl=en
- **Contact:** https://preserver.me/contactus/
